definition: Where the work leaves the workbench: the plan record itself, its drawings as vector images, and layered CAD drawings and a building model, made from the same record, that a drafter or a modelling tool can open.
basis: Editorial. The plan record, the brief and the check report download from the page itself. docs/export.md: "The IR leaves the system in the two formats a drafter and a BIM tool actually open.", and both "are generated from the same records the SVG renderers draw from". VISION.md: "An intermediate representation that cannot leave in a format a drafter opens is an unfulfilled promise."

surface.what: Take the house out: its record, its drawings, and files a drafter or a modelling tool can open.
read: The plan record, the brief and the latest check report download as files.
Each drawing downloads as a vector image.
CAD drawings come one file per sheet with the record riding on the drawing, and the building model carries the corpus's own identifiers.
Downloads are blocked, with the reason, while the placement is refused or is only a working sketch.
